name: Plate
author: hundekraft
description: Plate diffuses the input into a reverb tail. Decay sets how long it rings; tone sets how bright it stays. The artwork is Maiko's, used with permission. Synth, drum and master each have their own reverb. On a synth or the drums it is mono; the master is stereo.
credits: Reconstructs Maiko Pruett's #250 algorithm and artwork, used with permission
